overall_notes: This paper focuses on abstractive multi-document summarization for related work section generation. The main contributions are the RRG model and two datasets (S2ORC and Delve). The paper uses comprehensive evaluation including both automatic metrics (ROUGE) and human evaluation on multiple criteria. The extraction was generally good but included some comparison datasets that weren't actually used in the experiments.
